items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 1:1
items.html: In Atik, the Malchut of restriction 1 still serves, as in the Partzufim of AK. But from AA and below, the Malchut of restriction 2 already serves, for the Malchut of restriction 1 was hidden away in the RDL"A and is no longer revealed. (Vol. 1, p. 297, Sub Header, "Sitra").
